name: triage-graph
blurb: Multi-agent incident triage on LangGraph with a human approval gate enforced in code, plus a CrewAI port and a written comparison of the two.

name: sqlguard-mcp
blurb: An MCP server that lets an agent query a SQLite database and refuses any write until a human approves that exact statement.

name: bench-mcp
blurb: An MCP server that lets an AI agent drive lab instruments over SCPI, with interlocks from a signed-off limits file that the agent cannot override.

name: agent-replay
blurb: Records an AI agent's tool calls, replays them against a new model or prompt, and fails the check when the agent starts making a destructive call it never made before.

name: mcp-audit
blurb: An auditor for MCP servers that connects as a real MCP client, scans what each server tells the model, and calls every tool in a traced, offline sandbox to check it does what its annotations claim.

name: rag-knowledge-agent
blurb: A command-line retrieval agent that answers from a folder of documents with citations, and refuses without calling the model when no evidence clears its confidence floor.

name: llm-contract-router
blurb: Routes requests across LLM providers behind one interface, validates each answer against your schema, and re-prompts with the constraint that failed.

name: local-network-mcp
blurb: An MCP server for local network, system and SSH tasks, where shell commands, remote commands and process kills stay denied until the operator opts in.

name: atlas-graph-db
blurb: A graph database written from scratch in TypeScript, with a write-ahead log, crash recovery, atomic transactions and a Cypher-like query language (AQL).

name: crdt-notes
blurb: A local-first notes app on a from-scratch TypeScript CRDT, with a fuzzer that attacks convergence over a hostile network and six deliberate bugs it must catch.

name: quorum-lab
blurb: Raft written from scratch in Go, attacked by a deterministic simulator that partitions, crashes and skews clocks, checks safety after every event, and must catch six deliberate bugs.

name: wal-crash
blurb: Records a program's file-system calls with strace, builds every state a power failure could leave on disk, and runs the program's own recovery on each to find which lost operation broke a promise.

name: migrate-safe
blurb: Shows what a PostgreSQL migration will do to a live database before it ships, by running it on a copy under live traffic, and checks its linter's predictions against the server in CI.

name: schema-drift
blurb: A contract checker for JSON event streams that decides whether a schema change breaks readers or writers, and proves each breaking verdict with a concrete event.

name: tsz
blurb: Lossless compression for (i64, f64) time series in Rust that measures Gorilla, Chimp, Chimp128 and a decimal codec on every block and writes the smallest, so values printed as text shrink up to 29 times.

name: deadline
blurb: A Java 21 library that passes a request's remaining time budget from service to service over HTTP, so each hop stops work nobody is waiting for, skips retries that can't finish, and reports where the time went.

name: rate-proof
blurb: Measures what six rate-limiting algorithms let through once deployed across nodes with skewed clocks, a remote store and restarts, and checks its simulator against a real Redis, decision for decision.

name: trace-diff
blurb: Compares OpenTelemetry traces from before and after a change and reports the N+1 queries, retry storms and new blocking calls that tests and latency dashboards miss, with trace ids to open.

name: slo-proof
blurb: Replays past SLI data through a proposed alert rule and reports which incidents it would have caught, how late, what budget burned first, and how often it would have paged for nothing.

name: noisefloor
blurb: A regression harness for non-deterministic systems that measures run-to-run noise before calling a change a regression.

name: flaky-hunt
blurb: Finds flaky pytest tests and the one factor that makes each fail, confirms it with a significance test in fresh processes, and hands back a plain pytest command that reproduces it.

name: ops-console
blurb: A real-time Angular 22 dashboard that streams 5,000 services at 10,000 events a second, measures its frames, input delay and memory in Chromium, and works from the keyboard alone.

name: permit
blurb: A CLI and GitHub Action that diffs what an npm upgrade newly gets access to, such as network, install scripts, processes and environment, and blocks it until someone allows it.

name: admission-replay
blurb: Replays a Kubernetes cluster's audit log through a proposed admission policy, using the API server's own admission code, and reports which legitimate writes it would have blocked and which bad ones it would have let through.

name: authz-proof
blurb: A permission engine for SpiceDB schemas that works out who gains and who loses access when a schema or its relationships change, shows the chain behind each change, and fails the pull request when the change isn't expected.

name: runon
blurb: Runs plain shell-script programs on your machine, one server, or a named group of servers over your own SSH, and is published on PyPI.

name: geofence-guard
blurb: A ROS 2 node between a setpoint source and the autopilot that forwards a move only when it can show the whole path stays inside the flight envelope.

name: terrain-follow
blurb: Proves that a drone mission clears the terrain, counting elevation, altitude and cross-track error, refuses any leg it can't prove, and raises the mission until every leg is proven.

name: paramguard
blurb: A CI check for PX4 and ArduPilot parameter files that compares what the vehicle will actually run, checks it against the firmware's own metadata and rules, and blocks the pull request until a named person accepts the change.

name: ota-safe
blurb: A/B firmware updates for microcontrollers with a trial boot and automatic rollback, checked by cutting power at every flash operation of a device's life and run on a Cortex-M3 in QEMU.

name: strata
blurb: A Rust command-line tool that turns borehole logs into a layered ground model, puts a checked 95% interval on every contact, and refuses where that interval would be useless.

name: fieldlog
blurb: An offline-first Android notebook for logging boreholes, where phones merge their edits through CRDTs with no server deciding, and the merged logs reach strata only once they pass strata's own checks.

name: My Stream
blurb: An AI publishing platform. Scrape sources, score them against a quality threshold, and draft articles in your editorial voice.

name: Mushaf
blurb: A focused, ad-free digital Quran reader for the web, built for fast page navigation and a layout that respects the printed Mushaf.

name: My Stream - القرآن الكريم
blurb: A long-running Quran app for Android, with reciter audio, bookmarks and offline reading.
